title: Hanasato Minori — Each Dream Weaves Another〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew, another exhausting day...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I had classes at school, then went to the TV station for our shoot, and after that we even had an interview for a magazine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Still, today's shoot went really well!)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Thank you for today, MORE MORE JUMP!
We're very grateful that you put in so much effort despite this just being for one segment on our show.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: I particularly enjoyed seeing the way your facial expression switched at the drop of a hat, Ms. Hanasato.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You did?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right, you were on a roll with your reactions today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The great thing about Minori is that those overreactions come out naturally for her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Seeing that always puts a smile on my face, so I almost end up watching the window with Minori's face instead of the video we're supposed to be reacting to.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehehe...
Wait, no, we need you to watch the video!

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Hahaha! I'm sure they'll adjust things in editing to make you both look good.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Everyone said I was responding well to that magazine interview afterwards too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Plus, the plan was to just have one page with some photos, but they said the interview got so lively that they might make their article longer or give us more than the one page!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If things keep going well for us, one of these days we might be asked to appear in our own section of a magazine, or on the cover.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-The cover...?! Us?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've got a couple of very special flowers in our garden, don't we?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Eep...!
S-So bright...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I-I know I put the ball in their court, but they really are dangerous...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Us, on a magazine cover...
I sure hope that comes true someday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... Now that I think about it, I used to tell myself that I hoped I could appear on TV someday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That meant I got really surprised when we received our first offer for a TV appearance, but now we have stuff like countryside shoots in our monthly schedules.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Just a little while ago, I was thinking to myself about how great it would be to become an idol like Haruka, or how I wanted to perform with her someday after I debuted.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But now...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I formed an idol group with Haruka and the others, then we started doing livestreams...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We put on a joint show, did an event at an elementary school...and it was small, but we even had our own fan event!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our fans made outfits for us, and a song too! We showed them off at our solo show...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I still clearly remember the cheers I heard!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Those were all things I hoped I could do, but I never thought they would come true so soon...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, it really is true.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm an idol. And it may be a small amount, but I've been able to spread hope to all our fans who support us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know! Maybe I'll try thinking up more things I'd like to accomplish as an idol!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, I'll jot them down on my phone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see, first it'd be great to have a TV show we appear on regularly... And then one made just for us!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to have a show where we help solve viewers' problems and stuff, with a name like “Leave It To MORE MORE JUMP!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I want to sing theme songs for TV series and movies too...
Oh, and I want to win fashion awards or get recognized in the word of the year!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, what?! It's so bright...!
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Huh?
I'm in SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Did I tap Untitled by accident?
Oh...
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, Minori? I'd say it's rather late, what brings you here at this hour?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well... I was typing out notes on my phone when I saw this flash of light, and next thing I knew I was here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A flash of light...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Maybe this could be involved somehow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
“This”?
Oh, do you mean the ball of light on the ground there?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. This is called a fragment of a feeling, and if the feeling grows and becomes stronger, it will become a SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, I see!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Since you're here, let's both get in contact with this fragment's feeling.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Is it okay to without permission?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Even if we leave it alone, it'll disappear sooner or later...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it's possible that it's taken shape because the owner of this feeling wants it to reach someone, wants someone to receive it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Got it! If they're okay with me, I'll accept this feeling head-on!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Great.
In that case, let's touch it together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
One, two, three...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Look at this...!
We seem to be in some kind of plaza...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow...! There's so many flowers!
Oh, and there's a stage over that way!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're right. And the car parked beside it has a very cute clover mark on it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? A clover...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! People are gathering in front of the stage!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Does that mean there's going to be a mini-concert or something?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ooh! I wish I could sing on an adorable stage like that...

Why're you acting like you're not part of this?
You're going to sing right now.
se_walk_women_002_1
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hurry, Minori, you need to get changed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaaaaaat?!
